addons.name: ao-vk
addons.author: wannabuh
addons.summary: Vulkan renderer: higher frame rates, FSR upscaling, a new sky, and ground drawn out to the horizon.
addons.description:
ao-vk replaces the game's renderer with a Vulkan one. It adds render scale with AMD FSR upscaling and optional frame generation, ground drawn out to the horizon, and a new sky and desert. Its settings are in the Renderer and Advanced tabs of the game's Options window (with AOReloaded), or in the console on the key left of 1.

Needs a GPU with Vulkan 1.3.

options.label: Include AOReloaded (version.dll)
options.description: ao-vk's in-game settings (Options, F10: the Renderer and Advanced tabs) plus AOReloaded's own features.

addons.notes: In the game's video options, set Ground render mode to Shadows: the grass and the terrain's lighting need it.

addons.name: Clarity
addons.author: Vaporize
addons.summary: Floating combat text, readable nameplates, and a Clarity tab in the Options window.
addons.description:
Large, outlined damage and heal numbers that keep their size at any distance, with crits and glancing hits marked, and a choice of whose numbers you see. Nameplates show level, name, org and a health bar; your target and fight target get brackets, and you can click a plate to select that character. Everything is set in Options > Clarity or in Clarity.ini.

If a client update changes the functions Clarity uses, the affected features switch themselves off until Clarity is updated.

addons.name: MerkUI
addons.author: MerkXL
addons.summary: A whole new interface: flat status, target, team and raid bars, buff trackers, action bars, a minimap, themes and new login screens.
addons.description:
MerkUI replaces AO's status, target, team and timer bars with clean, flat ones, adds buff and debuff trackers, combat text, a mission window and resizable action bars, gives the login and character screens a new look with moving backgrounds, and puts every setting in the game's options window (F10). With ao-vk, its renderer settings are under F10 > MerkUI > Renderer.

MerkUI is a version.dll, like AOReloaded, so it takes the place of ao-vk's AOReloaded option. It only works on the exact client version it was built for; on any other it stays off.

MerkUI also copies its skin into the game's profile folders; uninstalling here doesn't remove those copies (see MerkUI's README).
addons.notes: Start the game once and quit at the login screen, then choose MerkUI in the PRK launcher under Settings > GUI > GUI Skin and start again. With ao-vk, set Ground render mode back to Shadows in the video options afterwards. MerkUI has its own updater too: update it either here or there, not both.
